tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ rigs kun khyab bdag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ /zung 'jug ye shes mchog mnga' rdo rje'i gur/ /grub pa mchog gi sa brnyes mchog sred la/ / gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs/ /paṇa chen grub pa'i rtser son nor gling pa/ /mkhas pa'i phul phyin dad byed go cha'i zhabs/ /'jig rten mig gcig rin chen bzang po la/ /gsol ba= /rig sngags nus pa mthar phyin brag steng pa/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa chen la/ gsol ba= /mkhas dbang rig 'dzin mnga' brnyes bsod nams rtse/ /gsang sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son rje btsun pa/ /lnga rigs mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sa paṇa la/ /gsol ba= dam chos 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /dam can bran du 'khol ba kun dga' grags/ /mkhas btsun bzang po dpal 'dzin kun bsod la/ /gsol ba= /gsang chen gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin rin chen rgyal/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje/ /ngur smrig 'dzin dbang dpal ldan tshul khrims la/ /gsol ba= /dbang lung gdams pa'i gter mdzod ngor chen la/ / rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros dbang phyug zhabs/ /smra ba zla med paṇa chen chos rje la/ / gsol ba= /rin chen byang chub thugs mnga' gzhon nu'i mtshan/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog zhabs/ /rab zhi dul ba'i dpal 'dzin rje ring dbon/ /gsol ba= /ma lus rigs kyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /bshes gnyen dam par snang ba sgrol ba'i mgon/ /zab don smra ba'i khyu mchog ye shes zhabs/ / gsol ba= /nus mthu'i rlabs mnga' kun dga' don yod dang*/ /mtshan legs dar rgyas kun dga' don grub dang*/ /yon tan lhun grub rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ / gsol ba= /yon tan gter mdzod rin chen mnyam bzhag dang*/ /gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin ngag dbang yon tan dang*/ /zab lam mthar thug kun dga' dar rgyas zhabs/ /gsol ba= khyab bdag bla ma kun dga' blo bzang dang*/ /zab don spel mdzad ngag dbang bsam gtan sogs/

/mchog gsum kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba= /rdo rje brag rdzong dmar nag 'jigs rung bar/ / mi phyed bsrung ba'i 'khor lo brtan bzhugs pa'i/ /rab 'jigs khro chen rnam bcu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs/ / dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyis ye shes las/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i rigs sngags sgra brgya pa/ /grags stong brjod bral rnam mang bzlas brjod kyis/ / gsang sngags nus pa brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i mngon spyod kyis/ /'phrin las thogs pa med par kun 'grub nas/ /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don spyod cing*/ /thub bstan nyin mor byed par byin gyis rlobs/ / rdo rje nag po chen por gur gyis mgon po'i bsrung 'khor rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang dge slong brtan pa'i rdo rje bas bskul ba'i ngor/ dge slong ye shes rgya mtshos thun gcig la bris pa dge'o// // dge legs 'phel// brgyud 'di'i kha skong ni yang na/ lung rig smra ba'i khyu mchog sgrol ba'i mgon/ / mthu stobs 'gran zla med par don yod zhabs/ /ngag nus mthar phyin mtshan legs sangs rgyas la/ /gsol ba= /mthu stobs mkhyen pa'i byin rlabs rnam par rgyal/ /gnas lugs mthar phyin yon tan lhun grub zhabs/ /gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /gsol ba= /dam pas rjes gzung kun dga' dar rgyal mtshan/ /rdo rje 'dzin dngos 'phrin las rnam rgyal zhabs/ / mthu stobs mnga' bdag lhun grub rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba= / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 88 -- PAGE 87 -- PAGE 86 -
